title: An organization server refusing a device request of an organization that closed: the HTTP 410 body (fabric-device/0.1, DEC-0103)
description: Answered with HTTP 410 and no Retry-After to any device request (enrollment, check-in, activity batch, share registration, rotation) of an organization that is closing, being deleted or deleted, from the server's termination record. The node treats it as final at once: it stops every request for that organization, drops what it buffered for it and ends that enrollment. Optional for a server that never closes an organization.

error.description: One sentence for the person; never a path, a secret or a person.

closedAt.description: When the organization's closing began: the end of its notice period, or when its deletion was decided.
